name: Alexander Volkanovski

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (66 in height, 71 in reach); fight weight = featherweight limit 145 lb

face.shape: Long oval that tapers to the beard. The head is fairly narrow at the cheeks compared with its height, and the shaved skull adds a tall, rounded dome. Lean, with no facial fat.
face.jaw: Angular and moderately wide at the angles, but the beard softens it. In profile the jaw line runs fairly straight from the ear to the chin. The masseters look solid, not bulky.
face.chin: Medium width, projects moderately in profile, slightly long. Always under beard in recent photos; the 2018 stubble photo shows a squared chin with no cleft.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent, with clear hollows below them. The hollow deepens when he is at fight weight (Apr 2025 and Oct 2026 weigh-ins).
face.brow_ridge: Prominent. There is a heavy bony shelf over the eyes and a clear notch at the nasal root in profile, so the eyes look deep-set and shadowed under most lighting.
face.forehead: High and broad. It slopes back moderately from the brow ridge into a high, rounded crown. Horizontal forehead lines show in the 2026 media-day still. When his hair was grown (2018) the temples were deeply receded.

eyes.shape: Almond. Upper lids slightly hooded under the low brows; lower lids show fine lines and mild bags.
eyes.colour: Hazel-brown: olive brown in the ESPN studio headshot, lighter grey-hazel in the warm 2018 video light. Closest MakeHuman iris: brownlight.
eyes.set: Deep-set; outer corners level to very slightly down.

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight with a flat arch. The inner ends sit close to the eyes and are often drawn slightly down and together, which gives a stern resting look. The outer third tapers and dips slightly.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown (#4b3427 estimated after removing the warm cast; raw samples #6e4738 ESPN, #aa6f4d 2018 warm light)

nose.length: Long; a large share of face height
nose.bridge: High and fairly straight from the front
nose.hump: Slight convex dorsal line in profile (ufc_2026-01 and ufc_2026-10 profiles); no sharp hump
nose.tip: Slightly fleshy and rounded, pointing a little downward, with mild columella show
nose.fight_damage: No clear deviation or flattening visible at these resolutions. The bridge may be slightly thickened, but that is not confirmed.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-width mouth. Thin upper lip with a flat, low cupid's bow, partly hidden by the moustache; lower lip slightly fuller. The corners turn slightly down at rest (ESPN headshot, media day). Broad smile in the 2026 celebration photos.

ears.protrusion: Clearly stick out from the head, the upper half especially. This is very visible from the front on the shaved head (ESPN headshot, media day) and is a key likeness cue.
ears.cauliflower_ear: None obvious. In profile the right ear shows a normal, defined helix and lobe; possible mild thickening of the upper ear cannot be confirmed.

face.notable_marks_scars: No permanent facial scar is clearly visible. Temporary marks are fight or training damage only: a red cut on his left cheekbone in Dec 2021 and red abrasions on his back in the UFC 333 action shot. Expression lines: forehead creases, nasolabial folds and crow's feet, which fit his age (38). A tiny dark spot sits on the centre of the upper-lip edge in the ESPN headshot (possibly a small scab or mole); it cannot be confirmed in other photos, so do not render it.

hair.style: Clean-shaven head, shaved in every photo from Dec 2021 onward. A faint shadow of regrowth along the sides and back follows a horseshoe (male-pattern) outline in the ESPN headshot. Before 2021 (2013, 2018 photos): very short fade with a short top, temples deeply receded.
hair.colour_note: Natural colour dark brown, from the 2013 and 2018 photos (raw sample #6c4b2e in warm light). On the shaved scalp render only a very faint grey-brown stubble tint on the sides and back, with the crown smooth.
hair.hairline: Shaved, so not visible. The grown-out pattern was strongly receded temples with an M shape (2018).
hair.do_not_use: The platinum-blond hair at the UFC 333 ceremonial weigh-in face-off (Oct 23, 2026) is a wig worn in character as Joe, his role in the Street Fighter film (released Oct 16, 2026); reports also describe it at the UFC 333 press conference. He is bald in the Oct 21 media-day still and in the Oct 24 fight photo, so keep him bald.

facial_hair.colour_note: Medium-dark brown. colour_hex is the hair-strand colour (average of the darker-quartile beard pixels in five photos), for a beard texture or shell that blends over skin; colour_hex_blended (#785845) is how the beard reads as a whole with skin showing through, for a flat painted beard only. Review correction: the beard is not free of grey. The ESPN headshot shows a sprinkling of light ash/grey hairs on the chin and along the jaw toward the ears, and lighter hairs show at the chin at the Apr 2025 weigh-in. Overall it still reads brown; about 10% light hairs, mostly on the chin and sides. Moustache colour matches the beard.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw; moderately dense on the upper cheeks with skin showing through.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache. Natural, fairly low cheek line; neckline trimmed just above the Adam's apple. Length changes by period: about 1-1.5 cm at the Apr 2025 weigh-in, the ESPN headshot and Jan 2026; trimmed to about 0.5-0.8 cm in Oct 2026; heavy stubble in 2018-2021. Default for the current look: 0.8-1 cm.

strand_samples.where: chin, darker quartile of beard pixels (studio)

tone_samples.where: left cheek below the cheekbone, clear of the temporary red mark (overcast daylight, turned slightly away from the light)
right cheek (studio light, saturated, reads pink)

skin.tone_note: Light-to-medium skin, tanned. Every source has a strong lighting cast (warm studio, flash, purple arena), so the recommended value leans on the two overcast-daylight photos (2021, Dec 2025). The face, scalp and forearms look slightly more sun-tanned and ruddy than the torso. Review 2026-11-06: the earlier 2021 'left cheekbone' sample (#be847c) sat right beside the temporary red cut and was replaced with a clean cheek sample; the other samples re-measured within a few levels. The daylight-only average (#c69a88) supports the recommended value.
skin.undertone: Warm/olive with a ruddy flush across the nose and cheeks
skin.freckles_marks: No prominent freckles or moles visible. Light, even chest hair on the upper chest and sternum (ESPN headshot, weigh-ins); light forearm hair. Dark hair on the shins and lower thighs in the ESPN stance-left cutout (less visible in stance-right, so it varies between shoots).

body.build: Compact, muscular featherweight: short (168 cm) but heavy-framed for the height, with long arms (180 cm reach, ape index about +12 cm).
body.body_fat_note: Visible six-pack and oblique lines at the weigh-ins (Apr 2025, Oct 2026) and on fight night. Fight weight about 66 kg; walking weight is higher.
body.shoulders: Broad for his height, with round, well-developed deltoids and a heavy trapezius sloping into a thick neck.
body.chest: Well-developed, flat pectorals with a clear lower edge and light chest hair.
body.arms: Muscular, long for his height. Strong forearms; biceps peak visible when flexed (Apr 2025).
body.waist: Narrow and tight, giving a clear V-taper from the shoulders.
body.legs_calves: Thick thighs with a visible quad sweep; noticeably well-developed calves and solid lower legs (ESPN stance cutouts). Legs are of normal length or slightly short in proportion to the torso.
body.posture: Upright. In face-offs the chin is slightly tucked and the shoulders relaxed but squared; in the fight stance he is compact and leans slightly forward.
body.notable_physique_traits: Thick neck and traps; long arms for a 168 cm frame; dense, compact musculature rather than a lanky build.

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist. It extends onto the front of the right shoulder and collarbone and over the top of the right trapezius / rear shoulder (UFC 333 action shot).
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey work. Upper arm and deltoid: an Asian-style dragon with a scaled body coiling down the arm, the head and a clawed foot at the front of the shoulder reaching toward the collarbone. Around the elbow: a black geometric/tribal band. Forearm: dense shaded black-and-grey imagery (scales, clouds, waves) running to the wrist; it was already present on the forearm in 2013.

None clearly visible. The left arm and torso are clean in the weigh-in photos and ESPN cutouts, and the back is clean apart from the right-shoulder sleeve edge (UFC 333 action shot). Unconfirmed: the ESPN stance-left cutout shows a short dark curved mark on the inner left calf. It could be a small tattoo, a bruise or a vein, and no other photo shows that area clearly, so do not render it.

kit.fight_shorts_current: Dark green with gold Greek-key (meander) trim bands at the hem and side panels, THE GREAT lettering, crypto.com logo and a black/green UFC waistband (UFC 325 Jan 2026, ESPN stance-left; UFC 333 Oct 2026 green and gold).
kit.fight_shorts_previous: Venum green shorts with VOLKANOVSKI in gold/white on the leg (about 2022-2024, ESPN stance-right); Reebok green camo (2018-2020).
kit.gloves: Black UFC 4 oz gloves; red wrist tape when in the red (champion) corner.
kit.weigh_in: Gold chain with a round gold medallion (Apr 2025) or a thin gold chain (Oct 2026); gold wristwatch.

morphs_unavailable.note: Ear targets are now baked (assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz); the values this note recommended (flap 0.45, scale 0.2, lobe 0.1, both sides) moved into morphs on 2026-11-06.
morphs_unavailable.arm_length: Reach is 180 cm at 168 cm height (ape index about +12 cm). No morph controls arm length; if the rig allows, scale the upper-arm and forearm bones up about 3-4%.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 or eyebrow001 tinted #4b3427, kept low and straight
render_hints.hair: none (shaved); optional faint scalp-stubble tint on sides and back only
render_hints.beard: short full-beard texture or shell, colour as facial_hair.colour_hex

notes: Confidence: medium-high for overall look (shaved head, short brown beard, long nose, heavy brow, protruding ears, right-arm dragon sleeve, compact muscular build), medium for exact morph values. There are plenty of photos, but only three are freely licensed (Commons 2013, 2018 and 2021); everything from 2025-2026 is reference-only. Watch for: (1) the blond hair in the Oct 2026 face-off is a film-role wig, so keep him bald; (2) every photo has a lighting cast, so trust the daylight samples for skin; (3) beard length changes from fight to fight (0.5-1.5 cm), so pick about 1 cm; (4) the ears stick out but the manifest has no ear morphs; (5) the eyes are deep-set under a heavy brow, and over-sized eyes or a weak brow will lose the likeness quickly; (6) the nose should be long, with a slightly down-pointing tip and a nearly straight bridge, not hooked; (7) the macro height mapping depends on the avatar code, so calibrate macro/heightDownM to a 168 cm standing height. Review (2026-11-06): face, body, tattoo and morph estimates hold up against the photos; the main corrections were beard colour and grey hairs plus one contaminated skin sample. Beard texture: use colour_hex (strand colour) with skin blending, plus about 10% lighter hairs.

review.likeness_pass_2026_11_06_v4: Head widened (scale-horiz +0.35, square 0.5, vertical scale removed), eyes opened (no eye-scale/height decrease), nose tip and nostrils widened, brows less angled, after side-by-side renders against espn_headshot.png.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/alexander-volkanovski.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Feint-heavy volume striker: constant shoulder and hand feints, stance shifts behind the jab, light on his feet; compact, slightly wide base.

ethnicity_fit.method: Fitted by eye with tests/likeness_compare.js on 2026-11-06: the neutral MakeHuman thirds and a 0.15/0.15/0.7 trial were rendered front, 3/4 and profile at the photo's framing; the heavier weight on the third base matched his narrow lower cheeks, long straight nasal bridge and deep-set eyes better, and the nose-width targets above restore the broad tip and wide nostrils seen in the headshot. Shape bases only; skin colour comes from the tone samples.
